question: How is rule-duality cast, and what grasps the four-egg rite?
premises: in order having thrown the higher-lower-higher rule-duality
inference: Dual rule is cast off in order; the four-egg-rite word grasps what remains.
plain_english: In order having thrown the higher-lower-higher rule-duality — here by the four-egg-rite-beginning word it is grasped.
